SELECT a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.CASH_NUM AS cashNum,/**现金流序号**/ a.VDATE_UNADJUST AS vdateUnadjust,/**未调整的计算开始日**/ a.MDATE_UNADJUST AS mdateUnadjust,/**未调整的计算结束日**/ a.PAY_DATE_UNADJUST AS payDateUnadjust,/**未调整的计划支付日**/ a.VDATE AS vdate,/**调整后的计算开始日**/ a.MDATE AS mdate,/**调整后的计算结束日**/ a.PAY_DATE AS payDate,/**调整后的计划支付日**/ a.TERMDAYS AS termdays,/**计算周期天数**/ a.VDATE_Y AS vdateY,/**理论计息年度开始日**/ a.VDATE_TERM AS vdateTerm,/**完整周期开始日**/ a.MDATE_TERM AS mdateTerm,/**完整周期结束日**/ a.TERMDAYS_TERM termdaysTerm,/**完整周期计息天数**/ a.PRIN_AMT AS prinAmt,/**计划支付本金**/ a.IS_PAY_INT AS isPayInt,/**是否支付利息**/ a.INT_AMT AS intAmt,/**计划支付利息**/ a.CASH_AMT AS cashAmt,/**计划支付现金流**/ a.CASH_UNIT_TYPE AS cashUnitType,/**现金流单位**/ a.CALC_FUNCTION AS calcFunction,/**计息算法**/ a.FREQUENCY AS frequency,/**年付息次数**/ a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId,/**金融产品代码**/ a.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType,/**金融产品类型**/ a.PAY_TYPE AS payType, /**支付方式**/ b.BRANCH AS branch,/**分支序号**/ b.CASH_TYPE_1 AS cashType1, /**现金流一级类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_2 AS cashType2 /**现金流二级类型**/ ,a.INT_PRIN_AMT intPrinAmt /**计息本金**/ FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE 1=1
AND (a.FINPROD_ID IN
null) OR a.FINPROD_ID IN (
#{item}
)
/**金融产品代码**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流一级类型**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流二级类型**/
AND a.PAY_STATUS = #{payStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**是否已支付**/
AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流代码**/
AND B.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/
ORDER BY a.FINPROD_ID,b.CASH_TYPE_1,b.CASH_TYPE_2,a.VDATE ASC

SELECT a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.EFF_DATE AS effDate, /**生效日期**/ a.PAY_CYCLE AS payCycle, /**支付频率**/
a.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, /*截止日营业日准则*/ a.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, /*支付日营业日准则*/ a.CALC_RULE AS calcRule, /**推算方式**/ a.FIRST_PAY_DATE AS firstPayDate, /**首次支付日**/ a.CASH_UNIT_TYPE AS cashUnitType, /**现金流单位**/ a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**金融产品代码**/ a.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ a.PAY_TYPE AS payType,/**支付方式**/ b.BRANCH AS branch,/**分支序号**/ b.CASH_TYPE_1 AS cashType1,/**现金流一级类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_2 AS cashType2 /**现金流二级类型**/ FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE 1=1
AND (a.FINPROD_ID IN
null) OR a.FINPROD_ID IN (
#{item}
)
/**金融产品代码**/ AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流一级类型**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流二级类型**/
AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流代码**/
AND #{effdateEnd,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.EFF_DATE /**生效日期**/
AND ( EXISTS( /**筛选：查询查询日最近一条现金流支付规则。**/ SELECT 'X' FROM ( SELECT c.CASH_ID,max(c.EFF_DATE) AS maxEffDate FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE c WHERE c.EFF_DATE<= #{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY c.CASH_ID ) d WHERE d.CASH_ID = a.CASH_ID AND d.maxEffDate = a.EFF_DATE ) OR a.EFF_DATE >= #{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} )
AND B.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/
ORDER BY a.FINPROD_ID,b.CASH_TYPE_1,b.CASH_TYPE_2,a.EFF_DATE ASC

SELECT a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.EFF_DATE AS effDate, /**生效日期**/ a.CALC_TYPE AS calcType, /**计算类型**/
a.YIELD AS yield, /**生效利率**/ a.BASIS AS basis, /**计息基础**/ a.BASE_TYPE AS baseType, /**基数类型**/ a.BASE_DATE_TYPE AS baseDateType, /**基数日期类型**/ a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**金融产品代码**/ a.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ a.REMARK AS remark, /**备注**/ b.BRANCH AS branch, /**分支序号**/ b.CASH_TYPE_1 AS cashType1, /**现金流一级类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_2 AS cashType2 /**现金流二级类型**/ FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b ON a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE 1=1
AND (a.FINPROD_ID IN
null) OR a.FINPROD_ID IN (
#{item}
)
AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流一级类型**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流二级类型**/
AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流代码**/
AND #{effdateEnd,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.EFF_DATE /**生效日期**/
AND ( EXISTS( /**筛选：查询查询日最近一条现金流计算规则。**/ SELECT 'X' FROM ( SELECT c.CASH_ID,max(c.EFF_DATE) AS maxEffDate FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE c WHERE c.EFF_DATE <=#{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY c.CASH_ID ) d WHERE d.CASH_ID = a.CASH_ID AND d.maxEffDate = a.EFF_DATE ) OR a.EFF_DATE>= #{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} )
AND B.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/
ORDER BY a.FINPROD_ID,b.CASH_TYPE_1,b.CASH_TYPE_2,a.EFF_DATE ASC

select
from BOK_FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION_PARA where BRANCH = #{branch,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ORDER BY BOKSET_ID, FINPROD_ID, BRANCH

SELECT b.finprod_id as finprodId, b.finprod_type as finprodType, b.branch as branch, b.BRANCH_TYPE AS branchType, /**分支类型**/ b.CHL_AGRT_ID AS chlAgrtId, /**通道代码**/ b.PRIN AS prin, /**名义本金**/ b.CCY AS ccy, /**本金币种**/ b.VDATE AS vdate, /**起息日**/ b.MDATE AS mdate, /**到期日**/ b.TERM AS term, /**期限(天)**/ b.INT_TYPE AS intType, /**利率类型**/ b.INT_RATE AS intRate, /**固定利率**/ b.INT_RATE_ID AS intRateId, /**利率编号**/ b.BASIS AS basis, /**计息基础**/ b.M_PRIN_AMT AS mPrinAmt, /**到期本金**/ b.M_INT_AMT AS mIntAmt, /**到期利息**/ b.M_TRADE_AMT AS mTradeAmt, /**到期金额**/ b.O_FINPROD_ID AS oFinprodId, /**原金融产品代码**/
b.FINPROD_TYPE AS oFinprodType, /**原金融产品类型**/
d.REGIST_ORG AS registOrg, /**登记托管机构**/
c.TYPE_1 AS type1,/**分类1**/ c.TYPE_2 AS type2,/**分类2**/ c.TYPE_3 AS type3,/**分类3**/ c.TYPE_4 AS type4,/**分类4**/ c.TYPE_5 AS type5,/**分类5**/ c.TYPE_6 AS type6, /**分类6**/ b.trade_market tradeMarket, /*交易所*/ d.opt_fee_amt optFeeAmt,/**期权费 add by yanya on 20200208**/ e.se_rep_day_type seRepDayType,/*交易所回购计提天数方式*/ b.vpay_date vpayDate,/*首期交付日*/ b.mpay_date mpayDate,/*到期交付日*/ b.act_cap_days actCapDays, /*实际资金占用天数*/ b.EXC_PS excPs /*外汇交易方向*/ FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT b LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE c ON c.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD d ON d.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID /** 取消该条件 by yanya on 20200208 AND d.FINPROD_TYPE = b.FINPROD_TYPE **/ AND b.BRANCH = d.BRANCH left join fin_product_valuation_para e on b.finprod_id=e.finprod_id and b.branch=e.branch WHERE 1=1
AND (b.finprod_id IN
null) OR b.finprod_id IN (
#{item}
)
